title: Field repository backup formats: text, SQL, zip
summary: Backs the field repository up as the diffable text file (default), an SQL script or a zip of a consistent copy, and restores each of them
intro: Read this when you want a copy of the field repository for something other than a code review. The default stays the diffable text backup; --format sql writes the DDL and one INSERT per row (a script any SQLite tool reads), --format zip zips a consistent copy of the repository file. repo restore takes the same --format, validates the whole file first and changes nothing when it is damaged.

surfaces.usage: drag-lint repo restore --in <backup file> (--repo <file> | --project <project file>) [--format text|sql|zip] [--replace]

questions.ask: How do I get a copy of the field repository that I can open without drag-lint?
How do I back the field repository up as SQL?
questions.command: drag-lint repo backup --project App.dproj --format sql --output repo.sql

questions.ask: How do I restore a repository from a zip or an SQL backup?
questions.command: drag-lint repo restore --project App.dproj --format zip --in repo.dlrepo.zip --replace
